A fenced block written for an embed or callout keeps its quote or list prefix on each line, or the container around it splits.
A fence whose info has a backtick must use tildes: CommonMark does not allow it after a backtick fence, and the closing fence then opens a code block.
Diff must cut only at rune starts: a change inside a character, mapped over another, makes invalid UTF-8 that can be saved.

correction: Releasing a document whose save failed must keep it until a retry lands: Flush also finishes while a retry waits, and Dispose stopped that retry and lost the text.
A refusal's held text and a restore's result must include what was typed during their reads.
Re-creating a deleted note is a write in flight like any other: without the flight a Save or a second removal overlapped it.
Only the newest Reload's answer counts: an older read landing last set old text and an old base.
A document's requests take the path on the UI thread and read again if it moved meanwhile, an error included.
A history's selection is an entry, not an index: a restore adds a version and shifts the rows, and the next Restore took the wrong one.
An image with no alt text still gets its destination rewritten; embeds the app inserts without wikilinks have none.
An upload's worker takes the vault's settings as values before it starts; the window writes them on the UI thread.
A link's label is parsed once: parsing it for the label and again as a fallback doubled the work at each nesting level.
The line cache keeps copies: a substring in a key or a label pins the whole note, a new note each edit.
A task's mark may be several bytes: toggling replaces the matched character's span.
A Markdown link's destination allows balanced parentheses, and '#' splits before unescaping so %23 stays in the name.
An upload holds its note open until it answers: a mode switch could dispose the document and lose the embed.
Closing commits a focused property field, and syncs every editor before asking whether anything is unsaved.
Frontmatter aliases are bounded: a cycle or repeated aliases in a synced note must not hang or exhaust the app.
A continuation of a property's value is indented or a '- ' item; a key may start with '-'.
Frontmatter ends at its first closing line, '---' or '...'.
A page preview's links go through the app's open rules, as the reading view's do.
An answer about a vault is dropped once the window has moved to another.
A delete saves the open notes under it first, or their unsaved text makes them again through note.removed.
The layout copied back after a frame is only what the panes changed in it: a button that changed the workspace in the frame was undone.
The focus coming into a tab group, or a press on its shown tab, makes it the active group.
Remove from list says what is forgotten, as specs/ui.md does.
Reset gives the new tab a fresh ID, or the window keeps the old tab's editor.
Attachments are read off the UI thread, regular files only, through a limit; names a wikilink cannot hold use a Markdown embed; a late completion checks the caret; smart lists leave code alone.
